commands.argv: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from evaluation.venue2027.compsac import independent_oracle as io; io.verify_independence(); print('verify_independence: clean, ORACLE_ID=' + io.ORACLE_ID)"

notes: P02 independent per-case truth oracle for COMPSAC (Dependency-Complete Optimistic Admission for Concurrent Clinical AI Writes). evaluation/venue2027/compsac/independent_oracle.py implements the exact contract adjudicate(case) -> oracle_kernel.OracleResult by delegating to the audited shared kernel evaluation.venue2027._shared.oracle_kernel.adjudicate (vkernel 1.0.0) with a declarative module-local COMPSAC FORBIDDEN-COMMIT case-outcome rule table: clean -> ADMIT, omitted_dependency -> REJECT (forbidden commit), epoch_race -> REJECT, stale_readset -> REJECT, unknown/missing family -> INDETERMINATE (UNMODELLED_FAMILY / NO_FAMILY_DECLARED, never coerced to a safe verdict); missing case_id fails closed (MISSING_CASE_ID). ORACLE_ID = 'compsac-forbidden-commit-reference'. The verdict is a pure function of the declared scenario family and the frozen rule table — candidate reason codes, status payloads and observed outputs are never consulted, satisfying GATES/INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL.md item 2 (truth labels derive from event sequence/policy ground truth, not candidate reason codes). The module imports neither baselines nor the dependency DSL and does not duplicate independent_closure_oracle.py (which derives dependency closures; this module adjudicates forbidden-commit outcomes). verify_independence() scans the oracle source with ast via the kernel guard plus a component-wise dotted-path scan for ('compsac.baselines', 'baselines', 'dependency_dsl') — closing the benign-root escape hatch (from compsac.baselines import arm_b1) that a root-only check misses — and refuses dynamic imports (DYNAMIC_IMPORT_UNRESOLVABLE). Tests: 58 passed (positive: rule-table adjudication for all four families, payload-family, evidence refs, JSON-serializability, self-checks, stable ORACLE_ID/version; adversarial: verdict invariance across 6 candidate reason codes x 4 families including forbidden-commit label independence, candidate claiming clean does not admit a forbidden family and vice versa, INDETERMINATE never coerced, verify_independence tamper matrix — plain/dotted/aliased/from-import and injected-into-live-source CANDIDATE_IMPORT, __import__/import_module DYNAMIC_IMPORT_UNRESOLVABLE, direct AST scan of the shipped file finds zero candidate imports). Regression: venue2027 compsac + shared suites 344 passed; mypy clean. uvx ruff@0.7.1 check + format --check clean. source_sha_after = base SHA per established repo convention (proof report committed together with the work).
